section_summary: Defines divisibility on the natural numbers and proves that it is transitive and closed under addition.

definitions.quote: We say that $a$ *divides* $b$, written $a \mid b$, if there is a natural number $q$ with $b = a q$.
stated_hypotheses: a and b are natural numbers
formalization_hints: Mathlib already has this as `Dvd.dvd` on a monoid; a demo definition should say so rather than shadow it.

mathlib_candidates.name: Dvd.dvd
mathlib_candidates.note: the library spelling of a | b

annotations.proof_strategy: Compose the two witnesses: if b = aq and c = br then c = a(qr).

proof_steps.text: Write b = a q from the first hypothesis.
Write c = b r from the second hypothesis.
Substitute to get c = a (q r), so a divides c.

annotations.proof_strategy: Factor a out of the sum of the two witnesses.

proof_steps.text: Write b = a q and c = a r.
Then b + c = a (q + r) by distributivity.
